services.desc: Get ready for a quick fishing fix in Panama City that'll have you hooked! Our 3-hour trolling trip is all about chasing down Spanish Mackerel in the bay. It's the perfect way to squeeze in some quality fishing time without eating up your whole day. We kick things off as early as 7 AM, but we're flexible - you tell us when you want to hit the water. From February to May, we're all about giving you a taste of what Panama City fishing is really like. Our captain and crew know these waters like the back of their hand, so you're in for some serious action. Picture this: You're out on the bay, the sun's coming up, and you've got a line in the water. includes: All necessary fishing gear, bait, and fishing licenses
blurb: Tail Raiser Charters provides fishing trips in Panama City, Florida, targeting species like King Mackerel, Wahoo, Snapper, Grouper, and Sailfish. They operate a 31’ Island Hopper and a 35’ Cabo flybridge boat equipped with advanced navigation and fish-finding technology. Trips include inshore fishing in bay waters and offshore deep-sea fishing adventures lasting 3 to 12 hours.
